source.description:
I need an experienced sourcing professional on the ground in China to help me launch a new line of raquet game toys. Because this is a consumer-grade toy product, I’m counting on you to identify factories that already manufacture similar paddle-and-ball or racket-style games, verify their credentials, and secure competitive pricing without sacrificing safety or quality.

Here’s what I’d like from you:

• Compile a shortlist of at least three reliable suppliers that already produce raquet game toys, including their core product specs, MOQ, lead time, and initial price quotes.  
• Arrange sample orders, oversee dispatch to my address, and document any variations in materials or workmanship.  
• Conduct a basic factory audit—remote or in person—covering production capability, compliance with ASTM F963/EN-71, and past export history.  
• Negotiate payment terms, packaging options, and shipping methods, then present a landed-cost breakdown to my nearest seaport.  
• Maintain clear communication with the chosen supplier through to order confirmation so I can move straight to mass production once samples pass inspection.

Fluent English and proven toy-category sourcing experience are essential. Familiarity with Shenzhen, Yiwu, and Ningbo supplier networks is a plus, as is the ability to manage third-party quality-control services.

If you’re confident you can deliver these milestones quickly and transparently, let’s get started.
